title: Email
description: Hostashi sends notifications and invitation links through an SMTP relay you already use. It is not a mail server and receives no mail.
offText: Invitation links are shown to copy, and notifications appear only in the panel. Enter a relay to send them by email as well.

relay.title: SMTP relay
relay.encryptionHint: Only encrypted connections. The certificate is always checked.
relay.portProblem: Enter a port between 1 and 65535, usually 587 for STARTTLS or 465 for TLS.
relay.usernameHint: Leave empty if the relay trusts this server without a login.
relay.passwordHint: Stored encrypted with the server key and never shown again.

sender.title: Sender
sender.fromHint: An address the relay may send as, for example panel@example.com.
sender.replyToHint: Where replies go, for example your own address.

ca.title: Private certificate authority (optional)
ca.label: CA certificate (PEM)
ca.hint: Only for a relay whose certificate comes from your own CA. The usual public CAs are always trusted.

test.title: Send a test email
test.sent: The relay took the email. Check the inbox, and the spam folder if it does not arrive.

errors.forbidden: Only administrators can change the email settings.
errors.rate_limited: At most 10 test emails per hour. Try again later.
errors.mail_failed: The relay did not take the email: {{message}}
